In this case, the expression for $g(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)={sinh}^{2}⁡x$ and $v(x)=2x+1.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{g}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{({sinh}^{2}⁡x)^{′}\cdot (2x+1)-{sinh}^{2}⁡x\cdot (2x+1)^{′}}{(2x+1)^{2}} \\  & =\frac{(2\operatorname{sinh}⁡x\operatorname{cosh}⁡x)\cdot (2x+1)-{sinh}^{2}⁡x\cdot (2)}{(2x+1)^{2}} \\  & =\frac{2(2x+1)\operatorname{sinh}⁡x\operatorname{cosh}⁡x-2{sinh}^{2}⁡x}{(2x+1)^{2}}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
